claim_boundary: No new data are collected; the experiment uses only the existing official DEFORM DLO4/DLO5 files.
The scalar covariance inflation is selected from the 112 training trajectories only.
The 28 evaluation trajectories were opened by the earlier immutable experiment, so this is a transparent post-hoc source-only repair rather than a fresh confirmation cohort.
Means, factors, query-gate decisions, and exact rejected-query fallback remain unchanged.
The result does not establish learned-provider, BayesianPhysTwin, Causal4D, deployment-safety, or state-of-the-art claims.
